name: systematics_diffuse_giem
description: Replace the GALPROP gas+ICS diffuse with the Fermi-LAT Galactic Interstellar Emission Model (GIEM, gll_iem_v07). Requires the prepared template mu_giem_counts.fits (and mu_giem_psf_counts.fits for the pixelwise PSF fit) in templates_dir: reproject gll_iem_v07.fits onto the ROI CAR grid and multiply by exposure. This is the cross-check against the LAT standard background that Totani (2025) also performs.
